# Saiful Abidin Portfolio

> Production-grade personal portfolio and professional software engineering profile for Saiful Abidin (sabidzpro), Full Stack Developer & Systems Engineer based in Wonogiri, Indonesia.

Saiful Abidin is a Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience in enterprise web architecture, real-time backend systems, cloud deployment, and cross-platform mobile development.

## Core Capabilities
- Web Applications: Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- 3D & Graphics: Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Three Drei, Rapier Physics
- Backend & Systems: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis, Caddy, Docker
- Mobile Engineering: Flutter, Dart, BLoC pattern, offline-first mobile systems
- Infrastructure: Vercel serverless edge, multi-stage Docker containers, Linux Kubuntu
